7 انسرق He went, drew, or shrank, back, in order to go away, عَنْهُمْ from them. (K, TA. [In this and the following sense, the verb is erroneously written in the CK اَسْرَقَ.]) ―
-b2- And He was, or became, languid, and weak, or feeble. (O, K, TA.) See also 1, last sentence.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
